instruction: Within Obsidian, append the line "Add a short paragraph about maintenance costs." at the end of the note "Reading/Article Draft.md".

command:
content=$(printf '%b' '# Article Draft

Need one cleaner example for the intro.
'); obsidian-cli create "Reading/Article Draft.md" --content "$content" --overwrite --vault "Benchmark"

reference_command: content=$(printf '%b' 'Add a short paragraph about maintenance costs.'); obsidian-cli create "Reading/Article Draft.md" --content "$content" --append --vault "Benchmark"

expected_texts: Need one cleaner example for the intro.
Add a short paragraph about maintenance costs.
